about: Tata Chemicals Limited, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures, markets, sells, and distributes basic chemistry and specialty products in India, Asia, Africa, Europe, the United Kingdom, the Americas, and internationally. It operates through two segments, Basic Chemistry Products and Specialty Products.
